segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:Probe,role:Valkyrie,race:human,gender:female,align:neutral
OPTIONS=!autopickup,!legacy,!tutorial,!splash_screen,pettype:none
OPTIONS=menucolors
MENUCOLOR="}"=red
MSGTYPE=hide "a{"
AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION="<a{1"
MENUCOLOR="a{1,"=red
MSGTYPE=hide "a{2,1}"

comment: posixregex.c regex_compile()/regex_match(), from the second host-parity sample (experiments/host-parity/sample2/, recipe re-bad-rc-01): bad patterns in nethackrc: ["}","a{","a{1","a{1,","a{2,1}"]. macOS and glibc regex answer differently here. Recorded on macOS, the judge's host, by .github/workflows/macos-recorder.yml (run 44628090866), because regcomp(), regexec() and regerror() differ between macOS and glibc (docs/testing.md, "The regex difference").
